capabilities: Draw an interactive family tree from person notes and frontmatter relationships
Render a family timeline with lifelines, births and historical event bands
Plot birth, residence and death places on a map using place-note coordinates
Label how each person is related to a chosen 'me' person and view the tree from anyone's perspective
Check the tree for missing reverse links, suspicious dates and structure problems
extras: Ships in English, German and Russian including kinship terms and multilingual date/uncertainty parsing. Tree, timeline and data check work fully offline; only the map contacts OpenStreetMap (tiles and optional Nominatim place search), with no telemetry or accounts. Includes a migration command for coordinates stored before version 1.1.0.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to visualize family relationships, lifespans or life places recorded across person notes.

relations.evidence: the map uses OpenStreetMap tiles when there's a connection

summary: Genealogy plugin that builds an interactive family tree, timeline and map from person notes with frontmatter relationships, kinship labels and a data checker.
